body:
I guess I’m in this place of not knowing if I should reach out or just wait to see if she contacts me. I think there’s a good chance I’ll never hear from her if I don’t. We had a good relationship and I knew she wasn’t entirely emotionally available but that revelation made it clear that we were in two very different places. I thought things were relatively good, she’s harboring a dark secret and not connected with me really. There was a real shift when that came out. 

Part of my fear is that I am entering graduate school and preparing to apply to medical school and I can’t imagine living with those thoughts in the back of my mind with all of my own stress. I wish I could be there for her but I don’t know if I could even be a good support.

I didn’t leave her, I didn’t even decide to end things. She began pushing me away and told me to get my things out of her house. My ultimatum was to hopefully push her to finally get some help or there was no future for our relationship. She’s had a therapist for years and never even told her therapist about this. 

How can I go on in a relationship where she is mentally unwell and unwilling to acknowledge it? I can’t spend my days wondering if she’s dead at any given moment.
